company.shortDescription: Ngrok is an API-first ingress-as-a-service platform that helps developers build their apps faster and more securely with no code changes.
company.description:
Ngrok is an API-first ingress-as-a-service platform that helps developers get their apps online faster and more securely. Its simplicity has made it a de facto standard tool among developers, and it is recommended throughout the documentation of the world's top technology brands, including Microsoft, GitHub, Okta, Shopify, Zoom, and Twilio. Lightspeed Venture Partners and Coatue have invested in the company.

The company was founded in 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.
